title: Near-uniform $q$-matroids
summary: We study the $q$-matroids associated with nondegenerate $\F_{q^m}$-linear near-MRD codes, which we call near-uniform $q$-matroids. Using the correspondence between rank-metric codes and their associated $q$-systems, we determine explicitly their rank functions and characterize their cyclic flats. We show that near-uniform $q$-matroids form a class of representable paving $q$-matroids. and prove an upper bound on the number of their cyclic flats, which is shown to be sharp for certain parameters.
